checkpoints.description: [1/1] Saves: share one SAVE_VERSION between writer and loader, refuse a future/unknown save without mutating storage, prove with a failing-first selftest check, a source test and a real v99 reload before/after

impact_assessment.why: loadSavedRun accepted any object with player/dungeon and ignored the version field, so a version-99 save resumed a turn-3 run with no warning (selftest acceptedFuture true); a downgraded build could half-load a format it does not understand
impact_assessment.benefits: A future or unknown save is refused whole, storage is left recoverable, and the save format has one named constant; the player starts a clean run instead of corrupted state
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save loader returns null for version != 2 and logs a warning; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: format stays version 2, no migration; UI: engine.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Selftest check failed first (acceptedFuture true), source test locks the guard and no mutation, real reload with a v99 save before/after, inspector at three viewports, full gates

[1/1] Combat feel: let the killing blow land (HUD zero, PERISHED float, shake) and delay the death ledger 750ms behind a run-token guard, prove with failing-first selftest checks, a source test and a real death before/after

impact_assessment.why: handlePlayerDeath opened the modal in the same frame as the fatal hit: the killing float was hidden, the HUD still read the pre-hit HP, and players could not see what killed them, while victory already waits 1.5s
impact_assessment.benefits: Death reads as a beat: HP hits zero, the screen shakes, a PERISHED marker holds, then the ledger opens; gameOver/save clear/run record stay immediate
impact_assessment.risks: contract: death modal is delayed by 750ms and cancelled by runToken; dependency: none; concurrency: a stale timer cannot open over a new run; state: save cleared immediately as before; UI: engine.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first checks read modal true at t=0 and HUD 65/65; after HUD 0/65 + PERISHED + modal at 1s; source test; inspector waits 0.9s; full gates

impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing checks read the goblin attack + theft and second: true; after gold 25, log only poison, cause poison; source test; inspector at three viewports; full gates
